lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgNb4O12 crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 54 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mg in an octahedral environment with six O neighbors and Nb in an octahedral environment with six O neighbors, while O centers show variable geometric coordination. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Mg and Nb octahedra and between Nb octahedra, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
